commit 3e7066647681daf910c5d5c31075b80b7ea177c8
Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue May 5 18:00:11 2026 +0000
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue May 5 18:00:11 2026 +0000

    Bug 2037071 - Fetch linux64-mozcheck toolchain for mozcheck linters. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,dandarnell DONTBUILD
    
    Also put allow-shebang under check-config in order for key to be passed along to mozcheck.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D298605

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
index afbb3537ae8..10acf1ce24d 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
@@ -87,6 +87,9 @@ file-perm:
             commlint -v -l file-perm -f treeherder
             -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
             comm/*
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-mozcheck
     optimization:
         skip-unless-mozlint: file-perm.yml
 
@@ -103,6 +106,9 @@ file-whitespace:
             commlint -v -l file-whitespace -f treeherder
             -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
             comm/*
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-mozcheck
     optimization:
         skip-unless-mozlint: file-whitespace.yml
 
@@ -127,6 +133,9 @@ license:
             commlint -v -l license -f treeherder
             -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
             comm/*
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-mozcheck
     optimization:
         skip-unless-mozlint: license.yml
 
@@ -283,6 +292,9 @@ trojan-source:
               commlint -v -l trojan-source -f treeherder
               -f json:/builds/worker/mozlint.json
               comm/*
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-mozcheck
     optimization:
         skip-unless-mozlint: trojan-source.yml
 
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
index 24b4867f8f0..c737447a920 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
@@ -34,6 +34,7 @@ reference-tasks:
     - linux64-mar-tools
     - linux64-minidump-stackwalk
     - linux64-mkbom
+    - linux64-mozcheck
     - linux64-msix-packaging
     - linux64-nasm
     - linux64-node
@@ -45,6 +46,7 @@ reference-tasks:
     - linux64-rust-macos
     - linux64-rust-macos-toolchain
     - linux64-rust-size
+    - linux64-rust-static
     - linux64-rust-toolchain
     - linux64-rust-windows
     - linux64-rust-windows-toolchain
diff --git a/tools/lint/file-perm.yml b/tools/lint/file-perm.yml
index ccc18d136ff..ca536bd22a1 100644
--- a/tools/lint/file-perm.yml
+++ b/tools/lint/file-perm.yml
@@ -45,7 +45,8 @@ maybe-shebang-file-perm:
     description: "File permission check for files that might have `#!` header."
     include:
         - .
-    allow-shebang: true
+    check-config:
+        allow-shebang: true
     extensions:
         - .js
         - .py
title: Bug 2037071 - Fetch linux64-mozcheck toolchain for mozcheck linters. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,dandarnell DONTBUILD
